endpoints.name: PTree.Examples.StateRewrite.preparation_success_probability
endpoints.type:
StateRewrite.preparation_success_probability
     : @RationalTickets.ticket_expectation bool StateRewrite.fused_preparation
         (fun o : option bool =>
          match o with
          | @Some _ (@true) => ssralg.GRing.one rat.rat_rat__canonical__GRing_SemiRing
          | _ => @ssralg.GRing.zero rat.rat_rat__canonical__GRing_Nmodule
          end) =
       @ssralg.GRing.inv rat.rat_rat__canonical__GRing_UnitRing
         (@ssralg.GRing.natmul
            (ssralg.GRing.SemiRing.Exports.GRing_SemiRing__to__GRing_Nmodule
               (ssralg.GRing.UnitRing.Exports.GRing_UnitRing__to__GRing_SemiRing
                  rat.rat_rat__canonical__GRing_UnitRing))
            (ssralg.GRing.one
               (ssralg.GRing.UnitRing.Exports.GRing_UnitRing__to__GRing_SemiRing
                  rat.rat_rat__canonical__GRing_UnitRing)) 6)
